senses.definition: (slang, LGBTQ, countable) A lesbian who appears masculine or acts in a masculine manner.
examples: Coming out appeals to the narcissistic pleasure of presenting to another a finished image of ourselves, which they return to us in exactly the same form: [someone tells] you [they are] a bisexual butch, and you confirm it.
